text: Sorry if this is a silly one. I'm watching my nephew tonight, he's 3, and his temp is 37.9. He's had a little cough today, nothing much. When I was getting him changed I noticed some tiny dark red dots on his tummy and a couple on his legs. I think I read somewhere you press a glass on them, so I tried and I'm fairly sure they didn't go away, I could still see them through it. Might be nothing? His breathing seems totally normal to me and he's been weeing fine, went to the loo about an hour ago. His mum's away so I don't really know what's normal for him and didn't want to overreact
